basic_details.short_information: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS Bangalore) has released the ECHS Bangalore Recruitment 2026 notification for 35 vacancies across various posts, including Medical Officer, Dental Officer, Pharmacist, Clerk/DEO, Driver, Lab Technician, Peon and others. Candidates with the required educational qualifications and work experience can apply through offline mode or email. The last date to submit applications is 02 November 2026, up to 1400 hours. Eligible candidates can check the official notification and download the application form from echs.gov.in.

how_to_apply: Download the application format from the official website echs.gov.in.
Fill out the application form with required details.
Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials in support of Educational Qualifications and Work Experiences.
Send the application by post or submit it in person to OIC ECHS Cell, Station Cell, Cubbon Road Bangalore-560001 by 02/11/2026 (1400h).
Alternatively, send scanned copies of documents to email ID [email protected].

Attend the Interview & Written/Practical Test at Station Cell, Cubbon Road Bangalore between 0900h to 1500h on 10 & 11 November 2026 along with all original certificate/mark sheets/degree of 10th/Matric, 10+2 & Graduation/Post-Graduation/Diploma/Course, work experience, discharge book, PPO, service records and two PP size color photograph.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointments are made on a contractual basis for a period of one year, renewable for an additional period of one year subject to performance of candidates and other conditions. The fixed monthly remuneration is Rs. 95,000/- for Medical Officer and Dental Officer, Rs. 36,500/- for Lab Assistant, Lab Tech, Pharmacist, Nursing Assistant, and Dental Hygienist, Rs. 29,200/- for Clerk/DEO, Rs. 25,600/- for Driver, and Rs. 21,800/- for Chowkidar, Female Attendant, Peon, and Safaiwala. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen and widows of service personnel including war widows (Veer Nari) within the ambit of Govt instrs.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Bangalore Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the official website echs.gov.in. Fill out the application form with required details. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials in support of Educational Qualifications and Work Experiences. Send the application by post or submit it in person to OIC ECHS Cell, Station Cell, Cubbon Road Bangalore-560001 by 02/11/2026 (1400h). Alternatively, send scanned copies of documents to email ID [email protected] . Attend the Interview & Written/Practical Test at Station Cell, Cubbon Road Bangalore between 0900h to 1500h on 10 & 11 November 2026 along with all original certificate/mark sheets/degree of 10th/Matric, 10+2 & Graduation/Post-Graduation/Diploma/Course, work experience, discharge book, PPO, service records and two PP size color photograph.
